notes.title: Update from 1.08.2021
notes.notes:
- Added gameplay in the form of a series of puzzles with new mechanics for interacting with the environment.
- Added environmental items.
- Added achievements, both hidden and with explanations on how to earn them.
- Adjusted the smoothness of the animation for the main character.
- Improved optimization and graphics in the game.
- Changed part of the environment (lighting, objects) for a better perception of the environment.
